title: Pure U.A.
summary: U.A. cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples; the F.A. cards stay with their own page. U.A. players are EARTH Warriors that swap in from the hand: each one summons itself by returning another U.A. you control to the hand, once per turn per name. U.A. Stadium searches a U.A. whenever you Normal Summon one. U.A. Midfielder swaps players on either turn, and U.A. Perfect Ace discards to negate on their turn. The 2020 cards lead. U.A. Libero Spiker trades a big U.A. in the hand for a different one from the Deck during their Main Phase. U.A. Player Manager joins whenever a U.A. is summoned and destroys a card or negates every non-U.A. monster. U.A. Hyper Stadium searches and grants an extra U.A. Normal Summon, and U.A. Man of the Match floods the field after a hit.
